game.q: they’re out the door tonight, dough unrisen. how do they carry it?
opts: in sacks, neatly packed on carts
bowls tied in their cloaks, on their shoulders

wrong.carts: neatly packed? there was no time for neat.
wrong.delivery: no doordash in egypt. shoulders it is.

game.right: YES. kneading bowls bound up in their cloaks, on their shoulders. no time even to pack.

end.line: they left so fast the bread couldn’t rise. every spring, the youngest still asks why.
end.l1: the bread had no time to rise.

cliff.s1: next, a wedding feast gets a little too wild.
cliff.s2: the host has an unusual way to calm it.

share: dough on their shoulders and no time to wait: the night matzah began. the story on infinite hill
